source: scholarweave/arxiv-latex metadata column scan; exact reviewed shortlist
reviewer: Claude (scientific advisor); independent title+abstract review only, no paper text read
review_criteria: Eligible: research Letter whose reported results are theoretical, analytical, numerical, or first-principles; experiments cited only as motivation or comparison to previously published data
Ineligible: reports new experimental measurements, including joint theory+new-experiment papers
Ineligible: Essays, Comments, or non-research formats
Ineligible (uncertain): abstract does not make clear whether new experimental data are included

Category is the arXiv primary category; selection: primary = proposed 100 balanced across str-el, mes-hall, stat-mech, quant-gas, supr-con, soft, mtrl-sci+dis-nn; reserve = eligible backups, deprioritizing off-core topics, missing PRL DOI, or new-style APS DOIs whose journal is unverified
Journal (PRL), DOI, licence and theory status of the full text still require Crossref/source verification by the manager
